subject: Case pattern: NDA confidentiality traps
body:
The most common HIGH RISK NDA flags we see:
• Overbroad 'any and all information' definitions
• No residual knowledge carveout
• One-way injunctive relief

Free NDA checker: https://attyflow.com/tools/nda-clause-review/
